config.pantry.title: Pantry
config.pantry.foodBonuses.tooltip: Some foods grant a bonus effect, like Speed II from cookies.
config.pantry.foodEffectTooltips.tooltip: Show the beneficial effects a food grants in its tooltip, including Golden Apples.
config.pantry.eatWhenFull.tooltip: All foods, including cake, can be eaten when your hunger bar is full.
config.pantry.fastSnacks.tooltip: Cookies, berries, apples, carrots and melon slices eat twice as fast.
config.pantry.biggerStacks.tooltip: Soups, stews, potions and cakes stack to 16.
config.pantry.longerPotions.tooltip: Seven drinkable potions last 4 minutes, or 8 with redstone.
config.pantry.goldenCarrotNerf.tooltip: Golden Carrots give 8 saturation instead of 14.4.
